title: Edit4D: Editable 4D Scene Generation with Textual Control
title_zh: Edit4D：基于文本控制的可编辑 4D 场景生成方法

paragraphs.en: Edit4D 提出了一种可编辑的文本到4D场景生成框架，通过分离的背景和动态角色表示来构建4D场景。 We introduce Edit4D, an editable text-to-4D scene generation framework that constructs 4D scenes from separate background and dynamic character representations. Recent advances in generative models have enabled text-driven dynamic scene synthesis, but editable 4D scene generation remains challenging due to the need to preserve spatial geometry and temporal dynamics. Existing approaches typically generate holistic scene videos, where the background and dynamic characters are coupled, making object-level editing and flexible camera control difficult. Edit4D addresses these limitations through a stage-specific generation pipeline. Given a user instruction, Edit4D first decomposes it into stage-specific prompts for background, dynamic character, and scene-character composition. Using these prompts, we synthesize multi-view scene images with text-to-image and camera-conditioned generative priors and reconstruct a background 3D Gaussian splatting representation. We then generate a character image, animate it with an image-conditioned video prior, reconstruct a 4D mesh, and bind Gaussian primitives to obtain a character representation. Finally, both components are composed through text-guided segmentation and contact-aware optimization. A global scene refinement is then performed to improve harmonization and rendering consistency. By integrating stage-specific components, Edit4D enables controllable camera motion, flexible object-level editing, and the practical construction of editable 4D scenes. Project page: https://chanwo0kim.github.io/Edit4D/
paragraphs.zh: Edit4D 提出了一种可编辑的文本到4D场景生成框架，通过分离的背景和动态角色表示来构建4D场景。 生成式模型的最新进展使文本驱动的动态场景合成成为可能，但由于需要保持空间几何和时间动态，可编辑的4D场景生成仍然具有挑战性。 现有方法通常生成整体场景视频，其中背景和动态角色相互耦合，使得对象级编辑和灵活的相机控制变得困难。 Edit4D 通过阶段特定的生成流水线来解决这些局限。 给定用户指令，Edit4D 首先将其分解为针对背景、动态角色以及场景-角色合成的阶段特定提示词。 利用这些提示词，我们借助文本到图像和相机条件生成先验合成多视角场景图像，并重建背景的3D高斯泼溅表示。 随后，我们生成角色图像，用图像条件视频先验对其进行动画化，重建4D网格，并绑定高斯基元以获得角色表示。 最后，通过文本引导的分割和接触感知优化将两个组件组合起来。 然后执行全局场景精化，以提升协调性和渲染一致性。 通过整合阶段特定的组件，Edit4D 实现了可控的相机运动、灵活的对象级编辑以及可编辑4D场景的实用构建。 项目页面：https://chanwo0kim.github.io/Edit4D/
